meanings.usage: 指参与有组织犯罪的人，常带有暴力性质
既可指普通的保护行为，也可指黑帮名义上提供“保护”实则勒索的费用
强调动作发生得准时、没有延迟
指彻底损坏某物，使其无法使用或恢复
指违反法律、应受到惩罚的行为

meanings.meaning: 非凡的，引人注目的，出色的
meanings.usage: 用来形容人或事物不同寻常、值得注意
表示在某地长期居住，也可指处理、解决问题或纠纷
用于形容人在危险或困难情境下表现出的勇气，带有褒义

meanings.meaning: 显著的，著名的，值得注意的
meanings.usage: 指人或事物因成就、特点等被广泛知晓
常用搭配dedicate sth to sb/sth，表示将某物用于特定目的或献给某人

phrases.usage: 表示“作为对……的回报/交换”，后接名词或动名词，引出交换的对象

examples.en: I bought him a drink in return for his help.
examples.zh: 我给他买了一杯饮料，作为对他帮助的回报。

examples.en: The workers get salary in return for their daily work.
examples.zh: 工人们获得薪水，作为日常工作的报酬。

phrases.usage: 表示“使某人停业，迫使某人破产”，指让企业或商家无法继续经营

examples.en: The big supermarket put many small shops out of business last year.
examples.zh: 去年这家大型超市迫使很多小商店停业了。

examples.en: The serious fire almost put the factory out of business.
examples.zh: 那场严重的火灾几乎让这家工厂破产。

phrases.usage: 表示“出名，成名”，指通过自身努力获得名声、知名度

examples.en: She made a name for herself as a talented singer at a young age.
examples.zh: 她年轻时就作为一名有天赋的歌手成名了。

examples.en: The designer made a name for himself with his unique style.
examples.zh: 这位设计师凭借其独特的风格出了名。

phrases.usage: 表示“与……处于交战状态”，主语常为国家、城邦等政权主体

examples.en: The two countries were at war with each other for three years.
examples.zh: 这两个国家彼此交战了三年。

examples.en: The kingdom was at war with its neighbor for control of the island.
examples.zh: 这个王国为了争夺岛屿的控制权与邻国交战。

phrases.usage: 表示“尽管，不管”，后接名词、代词或动名词，引导让步关系，相当于despite

examples.en: In spite of the heavy rain, he still went to work on time.
examples.zh: 尽管下着大雨，他还是准时去上班了。

examples.en: They kept climbing the mountain in spite of the bad weather.
examples.zh: 尽管天气恶劣，他们还是继续登山。

phrases.usage: 表示“为纪念……”，常用于艺术作品、纪念碑等，表达对逝者的纪念

examples.en: This book is dedicated to the memory of my grandfather.
examples.zh: 这本书是为了纪念我的祖父而写的。

examples.en: The monument was dedicated to the memory of the soldiers who died in the war.
examples.zh: 这座纪念碑是为了纪念在战争中牺牲的士兵而建的。

grammar.title: would rather ... than ... 结构
grammar.structure: 主语 + would rather + 动词原形 + than + 动词原形
grammar.definition: 表达“宁愿做……而不愿做……”的选择偏好，强调在两个选项中更倾向于前者 用于表示主观上的选择，than前后的动词形式要保持一致，否定形式为would rather not do sth

examples.en: People would rather pay large sums of money than have their life work destroyed by gangsters.
examples.zh: 人们宁愿支付大笔钱财，也不愿自己毕生的事业被歹徒毁掉。

examples.en: I would rather stay at home reading than go to the noisy party.
examples.zh: 我宁愿待在家看书，也不愿去那个吵闹的派对。

grammar.title: 时间状语从句：There was a time when ...
grammar.structure: There was a time + when引导的定语从句，when在从句中作时间状语
grammar.definition: 表示“曾经有一段时间……”，用于描述过去某段时间内经常发生的情况或存在的状态 用来引出过去的特定时期的情况，when引导的从句通常用一般过去时

examples.en: There was a time when the owners of shops and businesses in Chicago had to pay large sums of money to gangsters in return for 'protection'.
examples.zh: 曾经有一段时间，芝加哥的店主和商人不得不向歹徒支付大笔钱财以换取“保护”。

examples.en: There was a time when I lived in the countryside and played with my friends every day.
examples.zh: 曾经有一段时间我住在乡下，每天都和朋友们一起玩耍。

patterns.pattern: If + 一般过去时的条件从句, 主语 + would + 动词原形

original.en: If the money was not paid promptly, the gangsters would quickly put a man out of business by destroying his shop.
original.zh: 如果钱没有及时支付，歹徒们就会捣毁他的店铺，很快让他破产。

imitations.en: If I got the ticket, I would go to the concert with you.
imitations.zh: 如果我拿到票的话，我就会和你一起去听音乐会。

imitations.en: If he practiced more, he would pass the driving test easily.
imitations.zh: 如果他多练习的话，他就能轻松通过驾照考试。

patterns.pattern: When + 时间状语从句, 主语 + 主句动作

original.en: When he died at the age of eighty, the Florentines gave him a state funeral and had a picture painted which was dedicated to the memory of 'the most valiant soldier and most notable leader, Signor Giovanni Haukodue'.
original.zh: 当他80岁去世时，佛罗伦萨人为他举行了国葬，还为他画了一幅画像，以纪念这位“最英勇的战士和最杰出的领袖，乔瓦尼·奥库多先生”。

imitations.en: When the old professor retired, the school held a grand party and gave him a medal in honor of his 40 years of teaching.
imitations.zh: 当这位老教授退休时，学校举办了一场盛大的聚会，还给他颁发了一枚奖章，以表彰他40年的教学工作。

imitations.en: When the team won the championship, the fans cheered loudly and held a parade through the city to celebrate the victory.
imitations.zh: 当这支队伍赢得冠军时，球迷们大声欢呼，还在城市里举行了游行来庆祝胜利。

lines.en: There was a time when the owners of shops and businesses in Chicago had to pay large sums of money to gangsters in return for 'protection.
lines.zh: 曾经有一个时期,芝加哥的店主和商行的老板们不得不拿出大笔的钱给歹徒以换取"保护"。

lines.en: If the money was not paid promptly , the gangsters would quickly put a man out of business by destroying his shop.
lines.zh: 如果交款不及时,歹徒们就会很快捣毁他的商店,让他破产。

lines.en: Obtaining 'protection money' is not a modern crime.
lines.zh: 榨取"保护金"并不是一种现代的罪恶行径。

lines.en: As long ago as the fourteenth century, an Englishman, Sir John Hawkwood, made the remarkable discovery that people would rather pay large sums of money than have their life work destroyed by gangsters.
lines.zh: 早在14世纪,英国人约翰。霍克伍德就有过非凡的发现:"人们情愿拿出大笔的钱,也不愿毕生的心血毁于歹徒之手。

lines.en: Six hundred years ago, Sir Johan Hawkwood arrived in Italy with a band of soldiers and settled near Florence.
lines.zh: 600年前,约翰。霍克伍德爵士带着一队士兵来到意大利,在佛罗伦萨附近驻扎下来,很快就出了名。

lines.en: He soon made a name for himself and came to be known to the Italians as Giovanni Acuto.
lines.zh: 意大利人叫他乔凡尼。阿库托。

lines.en: Whenever the Italian city-states were at war with each other, Hawkwood used to hire his soldiers to princes who were willing to pay the high price he demanded.
lines.zh: 每次意大利各城邦之间打伏,霍克伍德把他的士兵雇佣给愿给他出高价的君主。

lines.en: In times of peace, when business was bad, Hawkwood and his men would march into a city-state and, after burning down a few farms, would offer to go away protection money was paid to them.
lines.zh: 和平时期,当生意萧条时,霍克伍德便带领士兵进入某个城邦,纵火烧毁一两个农场,然后提出,如向他们缴纳保护金,他们便主动撤离。

lines.en: Hawkwood made large sums of money in this way.
lines.zh: 霍克伍德用这种方法挣了大笔钱。

lines.en: In spite of this, the Italians regarded him as a sort of hero.
lines.zh: 尽管如此,意大利人还是把他视作某种英雄。

lines.en: When he died at the age of eighty, the Florentines gave him a state funeral and had a pictured with as dedicated to the memory of 'the most valiant soldier and most notable leader, Signor Giovanni Haukodue.'
lines.zh: 他80岁那年死去时,佛罗伦萨人为他举行了国葬,并为他画像以纪念这位"骁勇无比的战士、杰出的领袖乔凡尼。阿库托先生。"

questions.q: How did Haywood make in times of peace?
questions.zh: 霍克伍德在和平时期是如何赚钱的？
questions.a: In times of peace, when business was bad, he and his men would march into a city-state, burn down a few farms, and offer to go away if 'protection money' was paid to them.
questions.aZh: 和平时期生意萧条时，霍克伍德便带领士兵进入某个城邦，纵火烧毁一两个农场，然后提出：只要缴纳“保护金”，他们就主动撤离。
questions.hint: 答案见课文第八句：“In times of peace, when business was bad, Hawkwood and his men would march into a city-state...”

questions.q: What did the gangsters do if the money was not paid promptly in Chicago?
questions.zh: 在芝加哥，如果钱款没有及时缴纳，歹徒会怎么做？
questions.a: They would quickly put a man out of business by destroying his shop.
questions.aZh: 他们会很快捣毁他的商店，使他破产。
questions.hint: 见课文第二句，注意 put a man out of business 的含义。

questions.q: What did Sir John Hawkwood discover in the fourteenth century?
questions.zh: 14世纪，约翰·霍克伍德爵士发现了什么？
questions.a: That people would rather pay large sums of money than have their life work destroyed by gangsters.
questions.aZh: 人们情愿拿出大笔的钱，也不愿毕生的心血毁于歹徒之手。
questions.hint: 见课文第四句，由 made the remarkable discovery that... 引导的宾语从句。

questions.q: How did the Florentines honour Hawkwood when he died at the age of eighty?
questions.zh: 霍克伍德80岁去世时，佛罗伦萨人是如何纪念他的？
questions.a: They gave him a state funeral and had a picture dedicated to his memory.
questions.aZh: 他们为他举行了国葬，并为他画像以示纪念。
questions.hint: 见课文最后一句，gave him a state funeral 与 had a picture dedicated to his memory。

questions.q: Why did the Italians regard such a man as a sort of hero?
questions.zh: 为什么意大利人会把这样一个勒索钱财的人视为某种英雄？
questions.a: Although he made money by threatening the city-states, he was a skilled soldier who could protect a city at war, so the Italians respected his courage and leadership.
questions.aZh: 尽管他靠威胁城邦来敛财，但他毕竟是能保护交战城邦的出色军人，意大利人敬重他的勇武与领袖才能，因此把他当作英雄。
questions.hint: 结合课文 In spite of this, the Italians regarded him as a sort of hero 以及结尾的赞语思考。

translation:
曾经有一个时期,芝加哥的店主和商行的老板们不得不拿出大笔的钱给歹徒以换取"保护"。
如果交款不及时,歹徒们就会很快捣毁他的商店,让他破产。
榨取"保护金"并不是一种现代的罪恶行径。
早在14世纪,英国人约翰。
霍克伍德就有过非凡的发现:"人们情愿拿出大笔的钱,也不愿毕生的心血毁于歹徒之手。
600年前,约翰。
霍克伍德爵士带着一队士兵来到意大利,在佛罗伦萨附近驻扎下来,很快就出了名。
意大利人叫他乔凡尼。
阿库托。
每次意大利各城邦之间打伏,霍克伍德把他的士兵雇佣给愿给他出高价的君主。
和平时期,当生意萧条时,霍克伍德便带领士兵进入某个城邦,纵火烧毁一两个农场,然后提出,如向他们缴纳保护金,他们便主动撤离。
霍克伍德用这种方法挣了大笔钱。
尽管如此,意大利人还是把他视作某种英雄。
他80岁那年死去时,佛罗伦萨人为他举行了国葬,并为他画像以纪念这位"骁勇无比的战士、杰出的领袖乔凡尼。
阿库托先生。
"
title: A Noble Gangster
subtitle: 贵族歹徒

lead.question: 霍克伍德在和平时期用什么办法赚钱，为什么意大利人仍把他视作英雄？
lead.warmup: 歹徒勒索、强收“保护金”看似是现代都市的犯罪，其实早在六百年前就已存在。14世纪，英国雇佣兵头目约翰·霍克伍德爵士带兵来到意大利，在佛罗伦萨附近落脚。他靠向各城邦索要“保护金”大发横财，死后却被佛罗伦萨人以国葬相待，被尊为最勇敢的战士。这究竟是怎样一位“高贵的歹徒”？让我们从课文里寻找答案。
goals: 掌握 gangster、noble、Florentine、prince、band、protection money 等本课核心词汇。
理解并运用 in return for、out of business、make a name for himself 等固定搭配。
复习 would rather...than...、be at war with、in times of peace 等结构以及让步从句。
通过霍克伍德的故事，辨析一般过去时与表过去习惯的 would / used to 的用法。
lead.summary: 课文从芝加哥商人向歹徒缴纳“保护金”说起，指出这种罪恶自古就有。14世纪，英国人约翰·霍克伍德爵士率一队士兵到意大利，在佛罗伦萨附近驻扎并出了名，被意大利人称作乔凡尼·阿库托。战乱时他受雇于出价高的君主；和平时期便带兵闯入城邦，烧毁农场、索取“保护金”后撤离。他借此大发横财，却被视为英雄，死后佛罗伦萨人为他举行国葬并画像纪念。
lead.tips: 注意区分 would rather...than... 与表过去习惯的 would：前者意为“宁愿……而不愿……”，后者描述过去反复发生的动作，如 Hawkwood and his men would march into a city-state。

exercises.q: 汉译英：榨取“保护金”并不是一种现代的罪恶行径。
exercises.a: Obtaining 'protection money' is not a modern crime.

exercises.q: 填空：There was a time ___ the owners of shops in Chicago had to pay large sums of money to gangsters ___ return for 'protection'.
句型转换：Hawkwood and his men would march into a city-state.（用 used to 改写，意思不变）
exercises.a: Hawkwood and his men used to march into a city-state.
exercises.note: would 与 used to 表过去习惯。

exercises.q: 改错：In spite of this, the Italians regarded him like a sort of hero.
exercises.a: In spite of this, the Italians regarded him as a sort of hero.

exercises.q: 汉译英：尽管霍克伍德靠这种方式赚了大钱，意大利人还是把他当作英雄。
exercises.a: Although Hawkwood made large sums of money in this way, the Italians regarded him as a sort of hero.

exercises.q: 用定语从句合并：Hawkwood used to hire his soldiers to princes. + The princes were willing to pay the high price he demanded.
exercises.a: Hawkwood used to hire his soldiers to princes who were willing to pay the high price he demanded.
exercises.note: who 引导定语从句修饰 princes。

exercises.q: 汉译英：如果交款不及时，歹徒们就会很快捣毁他的商店。
exercises.a: If the money was not paid promptly, the gangsters would quickly put a man out of business by destroying his shop.
exercises.note: 过去将来时加 out of business。

quiz.q: 在芝加哥，店主和商行的老板们不得不做什么？
options: Give up their shops to the police.
Pay large sums of money to gangsters.
Hire soldiers to protect their shops.

quiz.q: 根据课文，霍克伍德爵士率士兵到意大利后在哪里驻扎下来？
和平时期，霍克伍德和他的士兵做了什么？
options: They hired themselves out to princes.
They marched into a city-state and burned down a few farms.
They gave the Italians a state funeral.
They paid large sums to the gangsters.

quiz.q: “made a name for himself” 在文中的意思是？
意大利人如何看待霍克伍德？
quiz.note: In spite of this 含让步意味。

quiz.q: 根据课文，“protection money” 指什么？
options: Money paid by the government to soldiers
Money paid to gangsters to avoid being destroyed
Money spent on guarding a city
